title: Flashcards: Sharks, rays and relatives, families
intro: Flip each card about sharks, rays and relatives. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: To which family does the Bignose Shark (Carcharhinus altimus) belong?
cards.explain: The Bignose Shark belongs to the family Carcharhinidae.
